name: Mickey Mouse
description: In this series of cartoon shorts, Mickey Mouse finds himself in silly situations all around the world! From New York to Paris to Tokyo, Mickey experiences new adventures with his friends!

videos.title: A Modern Mickey Mouse
videos.overview: Creators discuss the fun of working with one of the world's most beloved and recognizable character as they create a fresh new take on an iconic character - Micky Mouse - for the new millennium. Included as a bonus feature on the Mickey Mouse Season 1 DVD.

videos.title: Team Mickey Hits The Baseball Field
videos.overview: Mickey Mouse brings the magic of Disney to the ballpark.

videos.title: Duck the Halls: A Mickey Mouse Christmas Special
videos.overview: It’s touch-and-go for Donald when, instead of heading south for the winter with Daisy and all the other ducks for the winter, he insists on staying with Mickey and the gang to enjoy all that Christmas has to offer.

videos.title: The Scariest Story Ever: A Mickey Mouse Halloween Spooktacular!
videos.overview: For Halloween, Mickey plans to tell scary stories to Donald, Goofy, Huey, Dewey, Louie, Morty and Ferdie Fieldmouse. However, his attempt at being scary goes downhill as his stories don't seem to be scary enough.

videos.title: No Service
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald run into trouble when they don't meet the clothing requirements of Goofy's diner.

videos.title: Yodelberg
videos.overview: Mickey has difficulty getting to Minnie's mountaintop chalet because of the avalanches, cuckoo clocks, a yeti, a belching pig, and a bag of corn chips.

videos.title: Croissant de Triomphe
videos.overview: Minnie's café runs out of croissants and they are in big demand by the customers. So Mickey has to speed through Paris on his scooter to deliver the croissants.

videos.title: New York Weenie
videos.overview: Mickey chases a runaway hot dog through Central Park, New York.

videos.title: Tokyo Go
videos.overview: On his way to work at a children's train station in Tokyo, Mickey is accidentally forced to board the wrong bullet train. So he tries to work his way around the commute on the train by climbing the hang grips over a sea of punk-rock like teens, working his way through several people in beige coats, and fighting a sumo-wrestler.

videos.title: Stayin' Cool
videos.overview: On the hottest day of the year, Mickey, Donald and Goofy try to keep cool, by sneaking into a rich guy's pool, hiding in a meat-locker, getting washed in a car wash, getting blown away by an airplane propellor, and sneaking into an out of control Ice-Cream Truck.

videos.title: Gasp!
videos.overview: After a sneaky cat breaks the fish bowl, Mickey attempts to save his pet fish Gubbles by using many different water related appliances in the apartment.

videos.title: Panda-monium
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to photograph a bashful panda bear at the Beijing Zoo from many different perspectives but eventually becomes mistaken as a panda and has his picture taken.

videos.title: Bad Ear Day
videos.overview: Mickey searches for his ears, after losing them before a date with Minnie while being deaf at the same time. Now that Mickey discovers that the second and third pucks on the Ice Hockey Rink are his ears, Mickey has to win a game for the Home Team to retrieve his ears.

videos.title: Ghoul Friend
videos.overview: When Mickey's car breaks down in a spooky forest, a Goofy-looking ghoul gives a chase to everyone's favorite mouse.

videos.title: Dog Show
videos.overview: After Pluto gets injured, Goofy is forced to substitute for a dog show that Mickey entered Pluto in.

videos.title: O Sole Minnie
videos.overview: Mickey is a gondolier in Italy trying to woo waitress Minnie.

videos.title: Potatoland
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald take Goofy to Idaho to visit a Potato themed theme park called "Potatoland". However, when Mickey and Donald discover that Potatoland is just part of a sign that introduces people into Idaho, they attempt to make Goofy’s dream come true by building a theme park made of gravy and potatoes.

videos.title: Sleepwalkin
videos.overview: Mickey agrees to watch over Goofy after he reveals he has sleepwalking problems.

videos.title: Flipperboobootosis
videos.overview: Mickey and Goofy try to find a cure for Donald's very serious foot ailment: Flipperboobootosis.

videos.title: Tapped Out
videos.overview: Goofy volunteers Mickey to fight a wrestler, Pete.

videos.title: Third Wheel
videos.overview: Goofy interferes when Mickey and Minnie are out on a date.

videos.title: The Adorable Couple
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie attempt to make Donald and Daisy happy by showing them what life is all about.

videos.title: Cable Car Chaos
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie must stop a runaway cable car as it careens through the famous streets of San Francisco.

videos.title: Fire Escape
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to rescue Minnie from her burning apartment building.

videos.title: Eau de Minnie
videos.overview: Minnie's new perfume enchants an entire city.

videos.title: O Futebol Classico
videos.overview: Mickey tries to find a way to watch a soccer championship.

videos.title: Down the Hatch
videos.overview: Mickey and Goofy use Professor Ludwig Von Drake's shrinking ray to have an adventure inside Donald's body.

videos.title: Goofy's Grandma
videos.overview: Mickey agrees to let Goofy's Grandmother stay at his house, but she doesn't turn out to be the sweet old lady she appears to be, as she acts just like Goofy.

videos.title: Captain Donald
videos.overview: Mickey, Minnie and Daisy go sailing with Donald only to find out that Donald can't sail.

videos.title: Mumbai Madness
videos.overview: Mickey tries to drive the elephant to the mountain in Mumbai but gets lost along the way.

videos.title: The Boiler Room
videos.overview: Mickey must face a monster in the basement of Minnie's apartment.

videos.title: Space Walkies
videos.overview: Astronauts Mickey and Pluto go for a space walk. This is Chip 'n' Dale's first appearance in this cartoon series.

videos.title: Mickey Monkey
videos.overview: Mickey must stop a monkey from stealing his life after it steals his clothes.

videos.title: Clogged
videos.overview: Minnie attempts to make a windmill work in order to save a flower in her garden.

videos.title: Goofy's First Love
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald try to help a hapless Goofy woo the love of his life. Uncle Scrooge's first appearance in these cartoons.

videos.title: Doggone Biscuits
videos.overview: Pluto starts to gain weight after Minnie keeps feeding him too many dog treats.

videos.title: Workin' Stiff
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald struggle to get Goofy through a job interview while he's asleep.

videos.title: Al Rojo Vivo
videos.overview: Mickey's red-hot temper entices a bull to chase him through the streets of Pamplona, Spain.

videos.title: Bottle Shocked
videos.overview: Mickey is sent out to get a bottle of sparkling lemonade during the Grand Prix and has to protect the last bottle on his way back to Minnie.

videos.title: A Flower for Minnie
videos.overview: Mickey sets out to find the perfect flower for Minnie.

videos.title: Bronco Busted
videos.overview: Mickey, Goofy, and Donald's car breaks down and when they can't afford to pay the fee they try bronco busting to earn money.

videos.title: Coned
videos.overview: Mickey and Pluto’s day becomes a series of mishaps when Mickey, sympathizing with his injured pup Pluto, decides to ‘cone’ himself.

videos.title: One Man Band
videos.overview: After finding a perfect spot to play his music, Mickey keeps having to flee guards in London.

videos.title: Wish Upon a Coin
videos.overview: In this tribute to Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, when Pete steals all the coins from a wishing well, it is up to Mickey to stop him.

videos.title: Movie Time
videos.overview: When Mickey realizes there's no snacks for movie night, he braves a storm.

videos.title: Shifting Gears
videos.overview: Mickey goes head to head with his car after it refuses to take him to the beach!

videos.title: Black and White
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to save face in front of Minnie after he is literally scared white.

videos.title: ¡Felíz Cumpleaños!﻿
videos.overview: A group of rogue piñatas threaten to ruin Mickey's birthday fiesta.

videos.title: Wonders of the Deep
videos.overview: Mickey, Donald, and Goofy must save Professor Von Drake after accidentally jettisoning him out of a submarine.

videos.title: Road Hogs
videos.overview: Mickey decides to take Minnie on a romantic drive to see the sunset when he encounters some unsavory bikers who question his ride.

videos.title: No
videos.overview: Mickey is unable to say no to his friends and just about anyone else. With Donald's tutoring he learns to overcome his inability.

videos.title: Roughin' It
videos.overview: Mickey’s dream of camping the old fashioned way is threatened after Donald shows up in a state-of-the-art RV.

videos.title: Dancevidaniya
videos.overview: Mickey squares off against Peg Leg Pete in a Russian folk dance battle to rescue Minnie from his clutches.

videos.title: Couple's Sweaters
videos.overview: Mickey tries to get through a date with Minnie wearing the world's most uncomfortable sweater.

videos.title: Turkish Delights
videos.overview: A pair of jealous merchants threatens Mickey’s treats stand inside the Grand Bazaar.

videos.title: Sock Burglar
videos.overview: After seeing people around town including Mickey, with only one sock stolen, Minnie decides to take matters into her own hands and tries to bag the culprit responsible for these sock stealing scenes.

videos.title: Ku'u Lei Melody
videos.overview: Mickey's determination to write an illusive song leads him on a mystical journey through the Hawaiian Islands.

videos.title: Entombed
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie get separated inside a spooky tomb located under the Valley of the Kings in Egypt.

videos.title: No Reservation
videos.overview: Minnie and her friends attempt to get into the hottest, yet most impossibly booked restaurant in town.

videos.title: Split Decision
videos.overview: Mickey is forced to wrangle two very different Donalds after Professor Von Drake's latest invention splits him in half.

videos.title: Good Sports
videos.overview: In the style of the Goofy sports cartoons, Mickey (who is dressed like Howard Cosell) narrates to a basketball team of Goofys the difference between good sportsmanship and bad sportsmanship.

videos.title: Swimmin' Hole
videos.overview: When Peg-leg Pete steals the ol' swimmin' hole, Mickey, Donald, and Goofy attempt to get it back from him.

videos.title: Canned
videos.overview: An old lady needs help moving a huge load of trash from her backyard to the curb for a junkman to pick up. Mickey promises to help before discovering just how much trash there actually is.

videos.title: Touchdown and Out
videos.overview: Mickey, Donald and Goofy's fun time playing football turns scary when they're challenged by a team of bad guys.

videos.title: Locked in Love
videos.overview: In Seoul, South Korea, Mickey and Minnie accidentally get locked together in a lock meaning to symbolize their love.

videos.title: Bee Inspired
videos.overview: Minnie Mouse needs inspiration for her paintings and Mickey tries to help by posing with a flower. However, Buzz-Buzz the Bee won't leave him alone.

videos.title: Shipped Out
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie go on a cruise to relax, but because they're in the VIP Experience they have to endure all the activities.

videos.title: Three-Legged Race
videos.overview: Mickey and Pete team up to win a three-legged race, but Pete has dirty tricks up his sleeve in order to win the race, so Mickey has to finish the race fair and square by himself.

videos.title: Nature's Wonderland
videos.overview: While touring the theme park "Nature's Wonderland", Mickey and Minnie get lost trying to find the "Rainbow Caverns" which leads to an adventure that's not on the map.

videos.title: The Birthday Song
videos.overview: Minnie prepares an original song for Mickey's birthday, but things became complicated when the notes run off the page.

videos.title: The Perfect Dream
videos.overview: The perfect dream awaits a sleepy Mickey, but outside forces conspire to keep him awake.

videos.title: Feed the Birds
videos.overview: Mickey's hope to feed a sweet, little bird backfires when he constructs a feeder that attracts every bird in the city.

videos.title: Carnaval
videos.overview: Mickey races to save Minnie after her feathered costume takes flight during Rio's Carnaval.

videos.title: Year of the Dog
videos.overview: Mickey’s Lunar New Year feast is placed in jeopardy after a mysterious creature steals the main course.

videos.title: The Fancy Gentleman
videos.overview: After watching a romantic movie, Minnie decides to hire an instructor to teach Mickey how to be a fancy gentleman, but the results are not all that she hoped for.

videos.title: New Shoes
videos.overview: Mickey, Donald and Goofy experience life from each other's perspective after accidentally switching bodies.

videos.title: Springtime
videos.overview: The arrival of spring is placed in jeopardy when winter refuses to relinquish its grasp of the season.

videos.title: Dumb Luck
videos.overview: Mickey desperately searches for a good-luck charm after being cursed with seven years of bad luck.

videos.title: Flushed!
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to save his goldfish after accidentally flushing him down the toilet.

videos.title: Roll 'Em
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie race to capture a runaway film reel as it wreaks havoc around a big Hollywood movie studio.

videos.title: Amore Motore
videos.overview: Mickey helps his scooter woo the bike of his dreams after seeing her on the streets of Rome.

videos.title: A Pete Scorned
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to help Peg Leg Pete after a new bully shows up and steals his mojo.

videos.title: House Painters
videos.overview: Mickey, Donald, and Goofy attempt to give Minnie's new house an adorable makeover.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: Mickey’s wish for a surprise-free birthday ends up becoming the biggest surprise of his life.

videos.title: Hats Enough
videos.overview: Mickey suffers an identity crisis after realizing that all of his friends have signature hats, but he has nothing.

videos.title: Safari, So Good
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie gleefully set out to cross Africa's Serengeti after missing the bus back to their hometown.

videos.title: For Whom the Booth Tolls
videos.overview: Mickey is haunted by guilt after failing to pay the fee on a toll road.

videos.title: Outta Time
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald set out to rescue Goofy after he time travels back to the past in one of Professor Von Drake's inventions.

videos.title: My Little Garden
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to trim his little garden after it grows into an unruly, wild jungle.

videos.title: You, Me and Fifi
videos.overview: Mickey seeks to win the love of Minnie's feisty, little dog, Fifi.

videos.title: Outback at Ya!
videos.overview: Mickey's desire to throw a boomerang creates a series of dangerous, unintended consequences.

videos.title: Our Homespun Melody
videos.overview: Mickey attempts to cure his prize-winning pig after he loses his adorable squeal. Note: Cow, horse, geese, lamb, and chickens from Mary Poppins make cameos.

videos.title: Over The Moon
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie are led around the world on a never-ending quest for romance by their biggest fan, the moon.

videos.title: Easy Street
videos.overview: Pluto turns jealous after Goofy moves in and starts behaving like Mickey's new dog.

videos.title: Two Can't Play
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie attempt to beat Donald and Daisy in a game of doubles tennis.

videos.title: Our Floating Dreams
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie vie for the perfect spot to sell their goods at one of Thailand's busiest floating markets.

videos.title: Gone to Pieces
videos.overview: Mickey and Donald struggle to rebuild their best friend trio after Goofy gets broken into a pile of incomprehensible pieces.

videos.title: Carried Away
videos.overview: Mickey and Minnie's canoe goes off course and takes them on a dangerous, globe-trekking adventure!

awards: Won 7 Primetime Emmys. 32 wins & 30 nominations total
